```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version'
        required: true
        default: '1.4.0'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python 3.9
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install bump2version pylint setuptools wheel

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pylint custom_components/dreo/
          pytest

      - name: Bump version
        run: |
          bump2version patch --new-version ${{ github.event.inputs.version }} --allow-dirty
          git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: |
            ## Release Notes

            * Add new feature
            * Fix bug

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: dreo-integration
          path: custom_components/dreo/
```
